name: meta-ads
description: Create, edit, and report on Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads from an AI agent through the AdKit MCP connector: campaigns, ad sets, ads, carousels, media upload, interest search, and results. Every change is saved as a draft that the user approves before it goes live. Use when the user wants to run, change, or check Facebook or Instagram ads. Not for Meta ad strategy: use meta-ads-strategy for that.
